newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on Allegiance Corp.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on Allegiance Corp.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Tuesday it would list options on Allegiance Corp on October 1.
Allegiance is a spinoff of Baxter International Inc that will begin trading on the NYSE on October 1.
Allegiance options will have initial expiration months of October, November, February and May, the CBOE said. It said opening strike prices will be available on September 30.
The options will trade in the Honeywell Inc trading crowd, where Baxter options also trade. -Derivatives desk, (312) 408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
